scripts.cf-typegen: wrangler types --env-interface ApiBindings && pnpm --workspace-root exec prettier --write apps/api/worker-configuration.d.ts
scripts.db:count:local: wrangler d1 execute DB --local --command="SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM products;"
scripts.db:count:staging: wrangler d1 execute DB --env staging --remote --command="SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM products;"
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env staging --remote
scripts.db:seed:local: pnpm db:seed:prepare && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file=.wrangler/tmp/seed-products.sql
scripts.db:seed:staging: pnpm db:seed:prepare && wrangler d1 execute DB --env staging --remote --file=.wrangler/tmp/seed-products.sql
